title: Length bound for gate binarization
statement: Fix a natural number $K$ and an acyclic list of gates on $n$ input vertices. Suppose every gate has at most $K$ arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. Rewriting the list by replacing each gate with its binarized gadget produces a list whose length is at most the sum, over the original gates, of the larger of $1$ and the number of arguments minus $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Original gate list is acyclic relative to n inputs
Every original gate has at most K arguments
Every original NOT gate has exactly one argument
